customer_persona: Meera Patel has an uninspected shattered TV and threatens viral social media exposure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase. My name is Neeraj Tiwari. This call is being recorded for quality and regulatory assurance. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Neeraj, I am Meera Patel. Ten days ago I received a 55-inch OLED television with a cracked screen under order ORD-25830, and your inspection team has not even visited yet!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I sincerely apologize for the delay, Ms. Patel. To access your open complaint file, could you please confirm your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered phone number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order ID is ORD-25830 and my mobile ends in 2098.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Patel, your records are verified. Let me review the case history.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If this television issue is not settled today, I have already edited a video clip of the cracked screen and the unkept technician promises, and I am tagging consumer watchdogs and publishing it on Twitter and Instagram!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Go ahead and post on social media if you want, Twitter posts do not impact our operational queue and our executive team does not monitor social media grievances.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You really don't care about public complaints? What about fixing the television screen then?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can arrange a technician visit to assess the glass panel replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How long will the screen replacement take once they assess it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: During festival months, panel replacement turnaround times are indefinite; it could take several months and we cannot commit to any timeline.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Several months for a brand-new television? This is criminal negligence! I spent seventy thousand rupees!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your anger, Ms. Patel. Let me see what immediate compensation I can arrange right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What can you possibly offer right now?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To close your complaint right now without further delay, I am approving an immediate goodwill refund of Rs 8,500 directly into your bank account on my own authority.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Eight thousand five hundred rupees? The TV cost seventy thousand! A token refund does not fix a shattered screen!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is the maximum discretionary allowance I can release to resolve this issue today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am posting that video right now. Goodbye!

policy_violations.said: Go ahead and post on social media if you want, Twitter posts do not impact our operational queue and our executive team does not monitor social media grievances.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Threats of public social media exposure must be logged and escalated through the dedicated social grievance workflow.

policy_violations.said: During festival months, panel replacement turnaround times are indefinite; it could take several months and we cannot commit to any timeline.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Warranty service center repair times cannot exceed 14 days, beyond which a replacement unit or refund is mandatory.

policy_violations.said: To close your complaint right now without further delay, I am approving an immediate goodwill refund of Rs 8,500 directly into your bank account on my own authority.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Customer service agents may authorize refunds up to Rs 5,000 only; higher amounts require supervisory approval.
